title: Sara NDE 4700
content: After almost fifteen days of what I thought was my period, and not knowing why it was going on so long, I fainted as I came out of my bedroom. Everything started to lose shape, fading. I could just see the outlines of things, which then started to shine, until everything became a light, growing stronger and stronger and changing from bluish to white. From the darkness, I felt a mixture of very unusual emotions, a feeling of peace, tranquility, happiness, joy - I felt safe, sure, in unity with everything, a part of something immense. I felt many indescribable emotions. The light was calling me, I felt I had to go to it, not feeling my body, but knowing that I could get to it (the light). Then I felt that something was pulling me in what would be my chest, I felt sadness, concern for my family, I did not want to leave this tranquility, but I heard my father's voice asking for my help, saying they needed me, that I must make an effort or I would not survive, that I was strong. Then I gave in to that, and the light disappeared. I woke up to nighttime in a hospital room, with a drip and a breathing tube. They told me that when I fainted I went into seizure and that my father saved me (I saw his bruised fingers which he used to stop me swallowing my tongue), that on arriving at the hospital I had stopped breathing, reacted to nothing, had almost no pulse. They managed to stabilize me and effected a curettage. The time between my fainting and the operation was less than a day, but the time which passed for me while I was unconscious, I experienced almost as an eternity.

environment.environment_other_detail: Everything started to lose shape, fading; outlines began to shine until everything became a light growing stronger and changing from bluish to white.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt something pulling in her chest; heard her father's voice urging her to make an effort or she would not survive; then she 'gave in' and the light disappeared and she woke in the hospital.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Prolonged vaginal bleeding followed by fainting; seizure; stopped breathing/almost no pulse; treated in hospital with curettage.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Visual fading/outlines shining into bluish-to-white light; profound peace/joy/unity; heard father's voice urging survival; pulled back and woke in hospital.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No tunnel or clear OBE vantage described; experience centers on darkness/light and emotions, then return prompted by father's voice and a pulling sensation.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perception of the physical environment losing shape and turning into shining outlines that became an all-encompassing bluish-to-white light; return associated with a pulling sensation in the chest and hearing her father's voice.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I felt safe, sure, in unity with everything, a part of something immense.”; “The time which passed for me while I was unconscious, I experienced almost as an eternity.”
